title: I made a Windows 95 3D Maze-inspired dungeon crawler where every dungeon was generated from 4 prompts. Playable in your browser. Open source soon.
author: sorryaboutyourcats
selftext:
Each dungeon started from 4 prompts - dungeon style, hero, weapon and enemy. Local models using my 3090 made the textures, sprites, enemy names, intro story, narration, sound effects, music and ending video. Every time you start a new run, the art and sound are fixed from the generation, but the enemy placement and maze is redrawn, so no two runs are the same.

Play it here: [https://mowmeow.net/ComfyCrawlerTest/](https://mowmeow.net/ComfyCrawlerTest/)

Want one made from your own set? Comment each:  
STYLE: airplane cabin  
CHARACTER: a tired flight attendant  
WEAPON: a steam deck  
ENEMY: a rowdy passenger

ComfyCrawler was created with Sonnet & Opus 5.5.  
Built with ComfyUI (Krea 2, MiniMax H3, Qwen3-VL, Stable Audio 3, and more).  
  
This will be open source later this year.

comments.author: SpicySushiGames
comments.body: Love the Windows 95 old-school dungeon crawler
